def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s1=np.sqrt(1+t); s0=np.sqrt(t)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2
            + s1*(p[3]+p[4]*np.sqrt(P)+p[5]*P+p[6]*P*np.log(P))
            + s0*(p[7]+p[8]*P+p[9]*np.sqrt(P))
